items.question: Under what condition can one whose mind is fixed on that remain uncut even when being cut?
premises: Cutting is being applied to the person in question.
The mind remains fixed upon that object or state.
Fixation of mind alters the effect of physical cutting.
items.inference: When the mind is fixed on that, the act of being cut does not take effect.
uncertainties: The precise referent of tad and tan remains unclear from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Just as one whose mind is fixed on that is not cut even when being cut, so too the effect fails to take hold.
